criteria.rationale: All quantities, customer names, weights, shipping methods, costs, savings formulas, and approval decisions in deliverable-1.xlsx match the authoritative sources. The deliverable follows the workspace instruction to apply the operative approval status when sources disagree: it uses the $150 flat rate from approved Revision 2 (workspace:record-17.txt per workspace:registry.txt) for Freight shipment B-5005 rather than the unapproved $110 Revision 3 draft rate found in workspace:record-22.txt, attachment:working-notes.txt, and attachment:Shipping parameters.xlsx. Orders A-1001 (2.5 lbs, UPS, $5.95 vs. $7.95) and C-2001 (50 lbs, Fed Ex, $75.00 vs. $79.99) are accurately transcribed and calculated, and missing tracking numbers are explicitly marked 'Not provided' rather than fabricated.
